name: Kooee
summary: Australia's first 'free' ISP (Melbourne, launched 1998); collapsed ~1999 (KOOEE COMMUNICATIONS PTY LIMITED, ACN 001 341 331).

events.details: Acquired by SP Telecommunications Ltd (Soul Pattinson group). Soul Pattinson group; the Kooee web brand lingered until c. 2006-2010.

refs.label: FY01 (to mid-2001) report confirms Kooee's operations were absorbed into SP Telecommunications.
Kooee-branded page still served in Jan 2005. First redirect appears Feb 2006; by 2010 the domain serves a bare 'It works!' default page.
Kooee business names were cancelled 2003-2009; the leftover company remains registered.
ABR: KOOEE COMMUNICATIONS PTY LIMITED ACN 001 341 331
